title: HTTP/3 explained
snippet: Sep 21, 2026 · With TLS 1.2, the first HTTP response arrives after four round trips: one for TCP, two for TLS key exchange, and one for the HTTP request. TLS 1.3 reduces the TLS portion to one round trip. HTTP/3 eliminates the TCP handshake entirely. QUIC 's combined handshake plus the HTTP request takes two round trips total, or one on resumed connections.
